content.short: pandADA is a CNFT platform for raising virtual pandas.
content.description: pandADA is the only Cardano NFT project where users can adopt virtual pandas and play with them in an interactive panda pen. pandADA has several key differentiators that distinguish it from other projects in the space. Utility on Day Zero: pandADA is committed to creating a fully-functional panda pen and unique CNFT mint process before the first pandas wake up. Pandas need to play, not be put in a wallet! Distinct Operating Model: 神 ("Kami"), the pandADA deity, creates a small number of new panda CNFTs gradually over time - not 10,000 all at once.
content.meta: Find out about pandADA (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
